detect.gate_CV2_note: measured on CPU; CV-2 is defined for Jetson Orin + TensorRT, so a CPU FPS below 30 is expected and is not a like-for-like miss.

classify.dataset: FLAME frame-level Fire/No_Fire, held-out Test/ (8,617 img)
classify.note: FLAME frame set is classification-only (no boxes) -> whole-frame classifier used as an approximation, NOT a real detector; not comparable to the CV-1 mAP gate.
